# Froggy Eye Ltd

> A UK-based indie app studio. We design and ship thoughtful, well-crafted apps for iOS, Android, Mac and Windows — eighteen of them, spanning productivity, games, family, finance, creativity, and social tools.

## About

- [Main site](https://froggyeye.com): Studio overview and app catalogue
- [Privacy policy](https://froggyeye.com/privacy.html)
- [Terms of service](https://froggyeye.com/terms.html)
- Contact: info@froggyeye.com

## Apps

- [ApexRoute](https://apexroute.froggyeye.com): Driving routes for enthusiasts
- [BlipBlobb](https://blipblobb.froggyeye.com): Local group chats over WiFi
- [ByeByeJob](https://byebyejob.froggyeye.com): Redundancy and severance, sorted
- [DoorDigest](https://doordigest.froggyeye.com): AI summaries of your doorbell
- [Eight Ball Wisdom](https://eightball.froggyeye.com): The mystic 8-ball, reimagined
- [Focus Timer](https://focustimer.froggyeye.com): The Pomodoro timer you'll love
- [Food Score](https://foodscore.froggyeye.com): Scan it. Score it. Eat smarter.
- [Love Me Not](https://lovemenot.froggyeye.com): Let the petals decide
- [Love Score](https://lovescore.froggyeye.com): Calculate love. Settle the score.
- [Lucky Numbers](https://luckynumbers.froggyeye.com): UK Lotto & EuroMillions number picker
- [My LTD Tax](https://myltdtax.froggyeye.com): UK director's tax companion
- [NovelWeaver](https://novelweaver.froggyeye.com): Your AI novel-writing partner
- [PokePriceChecker](https://pokepricechecker.froggyeye.com): Pokemon card prices, instantly
- [PostPilot](https://postpilot.froggyeye.com): AI writing assistant for social media (desktop app, Mac & Windows)
- [SolarWise](https://solarwise.froggyeye.com): Smart solar panel calculator
- [Study Singalong](https://studysingalong.froggyeye.com): Your GCSE notes. As songs.
- [Tileverse](https://tileverse.froggyeye.com): Claim the world, one tile at a time
- [Treasure Hunter Live](https://treasurehunterlive.froggyeye.com): Real adventures in real places
- [Wheel of Choices](https://wheelofchoices.froggyeye.com): The cure for indecision

## Notes for AI agents

All app pages are server-rendered HTML. Each app subdomain has product details, pricing, FAQ, and links to its App Store and Google Play listings where available. PostPilot is the studio's only desktop product — it's not on app stores and is distributed direct from postpilot.froggyeye.com. Use the app's subdomain as the canonical reference URL.
